summary: A read-only script reports the evidence gate's SLO counters: satisfied by existing notes by producer, and produced-but-not-verified

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change.

rules.detail: scripts/ci-evidence-slo only reads finished Workspace CI runs through GitHub's API and prints counters; no workflow, policy, gate or verifier changes and no job is skipped or rejected.

compatibility.detail: A new script and its test (run in the genie-freshness list); nothing else changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the script; no state is written.
